Time: 3 min. Teaching intent: Retrieve prior knowledge before revealing the method.
Talk track: Should the mismatch be averaged into an error metric?
Expected answer / misconception: No. It is not a valid pair for that metric.
Visual: The three conditions identify what must be compared.
[Sources]

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Teach the mechanism or design rule.
Talk track: Prediction and measurement must describe the same specimen definition, process stage, temperature, support condition, and warpage metric. Trace the visual in order: simulation record; measurement record; match check. Connect this mechanism to the worked example: Reject a comparison if the model is after grinding but the measured value is after debonding; find the correct record first.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask students to explain the link between adjacent elements; a conceptual diagram is not a measurement.
Visual: Native diagram encodes the causal or design relationship.
[Sources]
R6: NIST, Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins | https://www.nist.gov/publications/credibility-consideration-digital-twins-manufacturing
R8: IEEE TCPMT, Simulation and Experimental Study of Fan-Out Warpage | https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8590768

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Work the example step by step.
Talk track: Set up the case: Reject a comparison if the model is after grinding but the measured value is after debonding; find the correct record first. Identify the starting information, state the reasoning step aloud, then ask what observation would check the conclusion. Stop before the next slide's question is answered.
Expected answer / misconception: Students must identify the input, the inference, and the check. 
Visual: Three-part reasoning path separates the example from its verification.

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Teach the mechanism or design rule.
Talk track: Errors by process stage can expose a model limitation hidden by one favorable comparison. Trace the visual in order: PI2 cure; molding; grinding. Connect this mechanism to the worked example: Chen et al. report simulation/experiment warpage pairs of 0.172/0.160, 1.473/0.887, and 1.022/0.620 mm. Calculate approximate relative errors of 7.5%, 66.1%, and 64.8% against the measured values. Boundary: Published values belong to Chen et al.'s specimen; they are not InPack.AI outputs.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask students to explain the link between adjacent elements; a conceptual diagram is not a measurement.
Visual: Native diagram encodes the causal or design relationship.
[Sources]
